storyTagline: The Eagles go 15-2 and beat the Colts 38-22 in Super Bowl CLVI for a seventh straight title, Bones Crawford throws 64 touchdown passes for a 6th MVP, and Ryland Maxwell, 35, wins an 8th Super Bowl MVP.

stories.headline: Seven Straight: Eagles Beat the Colts 38-22 in Super Bowl CLVI
stories.dek: Philadelphia went 15-2, allowed the fewest points in the league and won a seventh straight title as Ryland Maxwell took his 8th Super Bowl MVP at 35.

stories.headline: Mad Max at 35: 1,847 Yards, an 8th Super Bowl MVP and the First 50,000 Card
stories.dek: Ryland Maxwell led the league in rushing again, passed Siran Spector on the career touchdown list and is now 18 short of Lane McCoy's league mark.

stories.headline: The Doctor Answers Back: 64 Touchdown Passes and a 6th MVP
stories.dek: A year after Margus Leglue's MVP was read as a verdict on his 17 interceptions, Bones Crawford threw for 4,857 yards and took the award back.

stories.headline: Wingo 2,158, Jarrett 2,007: Philadelphia's Receivers Lap the League
stories.dek: Calvin Wingo II was Offensive Player of the Year for the 3rd time. Payton Jarrett, 23, caught 23 touchdowns and the longest pass on Skura's record board.

stories.headline: Akiem Brock at 35: 43 Blocks, a 9th Ring and No Lineman Close
stories.dek: The league's best blocker came back for one more season, played every game and finished with an OVR of 99.

stories.headline: Brooker Takes the Interception Record at 47, and Pettis Closes on Swaim
stories.dek: Green Bay's Jamon Brooker pulled 4 clear of Damar Hobbs and Lewis Pettis. Pettis is 67 tackles from the career mark, and Snoop Dotson is 1 sack from a share of second place.

stories.headline: Twelfth in the Power Rankings, Last Team Standing in the AFC: Inside the Colts' Run
stories.dek: Indianapolis went 10-7, finished third in its own division and won three playoff games behind a 21-year-old quarterback in his first season.

stories.headline: From the Super Bowl to 7-10: Cincinnati Falls Back to the Pack
stories.dek: Grover Calitro went from 43 rushing touchdowns to 16, and the Bengals' best day of the season came 55-10 against the Jets.

stories.headline: Two Losses, Two Rivals: Dallas and Washington Finally Draw Blood
stories.dek: The 5-11-1 Cowboys pulled off the upset of the season and Washington won by a point. The Giants are still waiting for their first win over Skura's Eagles.

takes.headline: Tramon Holton Won Defensive Player of the Year. Two Defensive Backs Made 32 and 39 More Tackles.
takes.dek: Holton: 210 tackles in 18 games. Akayleb Samia: 242 in 17. A rookie, Jacoby Nunez, made 249.

takes.headline: Bones Crawford Threw 64 Touchdowns, 25 More Than Anyone. He Is the Best Player in Football Now.
takes.dek: A sixth MVP, 4,857 yards, and a card that rose 33% while Ryland Maxwell's barely moved.

takes.headline: Ryland Maxwell Is 18 Touchdowns From Lane McCoy. He Scored 19 This Year. One More Season.
takes.dek: Injury cost him 2 games and he still led the league with 1,847 rushing yards at 35.

takes.headline: Payton Jarrett's Card Costs 92. Calvin Wingo II's Costs 4,651. They Had the Same Season.
takes.dek: Wingo won Offensive Player of the Year with 2,158 yards and 22 touchdowns. Jarrett, 23, had 2,007 and 23.

takes.headline: The Colts Were the 12th-Best Team in Football and Third in Their Own Division. They Did Not Belong.
takes.dek: A 10-7 club reached Super Bowl CLVI and lost 38-22. River Kuechly deserved a better team.

takes.headline: Stop Calling It a Rivalry. The Giants Are 0-19 Against Philadelphia.
takes.dek: Nineteen meetings since Y88, 642 points to 413, and the Giants still have never won one.

takes.headline: Grover Calitro's Touchdowns Fell From 43 to 16, and His Card Went Up 72%. The Market Is Drunk.
takes.dek: The Bengals went from Super Bowl CLV to 7-10, and their star back's price rose anyway.

takes.headline: A.T. Hoyer Is 150 Tackles From the Career Record and Wasting It on the Worst Team in Football
takes.dek: 195 tackles for a 3-14 club that ranked last in the power table and allowed 625 points.

takes.headline: The 5-11-1 Cowboys Handed the Champions One of Their 2 Losses. Dallas Should Be Embarrassed, Not Proud.
takes.dek: A 38-28 win in week 6 was the upset of the season. Philadelphia answered 34-23 in week 14.

didYouKnow.text: Bones Crawford threw 64 touchdown passes and 15 interceptions in Y97 and won the MVP. No other quarterback threw more than 7 interceptions.
The Eagles allowed 358 points in Y97, the fewest in the league and 50 fewer than the 12-5 Patriots, the next stingiest club.
Ryland Maxwell's card is worth 50,066, the first in the market's history to pass 50,000.
Jackson Poyer threw 29 touchdown passes and 2 interceptions in his first season on league cards, at 21, and played all 21 of the Colts' games.
Jamon Brooker has 47 career interceptions, the most on league cards, and 2 Defensive Player of the Year awards, but no ring.
Payton Jarrett is 23 and already has 3 rings, 54 career touchdown catches and the longest pass in the air on Dorren Skura's record board, 32 yards.
The Colts played 21 games in Y97, more than any other club, after a 10-7 regular season that ranked 12th in the power rankings.

All 25 Defensive Player of the Year awards on league cards belong to defensive backs. The game credits a corner or safety's stop on a pass play as an interception, and the award rating counts each interception as much as 6 tackles. Jamon Brooker leads with 2 awards.

Defensive linemen have 114 career interceptions in 9,800 games, one every 86 games; defensive backs pick one off every 9.5 games. The game scores a lineman's stop on a pass play as a sack: linemen have 446 sacks, defensive backs 1.
Retro Bowl caps each draft class by the coach's last record. After Skura's Eagles went 15-2 in Y97 (88.2%), prospects 5 to 50 of the Y98 class could rate at most 3 stars; a .500 season allows 3.5.
Winning shrinks the draft: in 74 of Skura's 79 seasons that fed a draft at the same club, his record capped the next class at 3 stars or less.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Sherman Brandson
vault.text: The General never flinched. Career Legacy 13,653, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Rondale Ikarras
vault.text: Flashy, loud, unstoppable, and he knew it. He was that guy. Career Legacy 11,077, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · God Johnson
vault.text: He changed his name to God. Then he earned it. Career Legacy 12,840, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jayon Queen
vault.text: Two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Only one other player in this league has ever matched that. Career Legacy 8,547, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyrone Baugh
vault.text: Seven seasons, seven championships, and Tyrone Baugh has a ring for every one of them. Career Legacy 8,527, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Levante Hopkins
vault.text: The quiet one who did the dirty work. Career Legacy 11,528, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Dennis Baylon
vault.text: Seven trips to the Super Bowl. Seven rings. Not one loss. Career Legacy 10,480, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Mose Junior
vault.text: Some players chase rings. Mose Junior chased ball carriers. Career Legacy 7,565, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Charlie John
vault.text: Seven straight Super Bowls. Charlie John was there for every one of them. Career Legacy 10,184, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ian Finney
vault.text: The first superstar. The Infinity Man. Career Legacy 11,478, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Cooper Dean
vault.text: Eighteen seasons, one club, and more blocks than any lineman before him. Career Legacy 5,430, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Bilal Tolbert
vault.text: No individual trophies. Four rings. And a sack record nobody has caught. Career Legacy 8,558, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Wayne Wilson
vault.text: Four hundred thirty-one games. Nobody in this league has played longer. Career Legacy 9,579, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Cairo Asanjh
vault.text: Some players chase records. Cairo Asanjh chased Ian Finney. Career Legacy 10,421, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jahmyr Gibbs
vault.text: Mr. Incredible was here at the start, and he set the bar high. Career Legacy 7,450, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Zander Kolar
vault.text: Some defensive linemen are measured in sacks. Zander Kolar was measured in tackles. Career Legacy 8,714, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ray Waller
vault.text: Never count out a man whose nickname is a promise. Career Legacy 8,980, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyler Pacheco
vault.text: Tyler Pacheco never needed the big play. He needed the ball, and he got it. Career Legacy 7,926, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lukas Russell
vault.text: The Running Man started fast and never slowed down. Career Legacy 9,407, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Taron Hayes
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game, for 213 games, and two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Career Legacy 6,995, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Nick Bolton
vault.text: One of the originals, and he never stopped tackling. Career Legacy 8,837, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Michael Wilson
vault.text: Wayne's son, and nobody's afterthought. Career Legacy 8,838, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jackson Wardell Kline
vault.text: Tyrion Kline's son did not live in anyone's shadow. He built his own. Career Legacy 10,193, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Malakai Sawyer
vault.text: Some backs have a great season. Malakai Sawyer keeps having them. Career Legacy 7,325, Y88 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · K'Lavon Settle
vault.text: Fifteen seasons in San Francisco, and nobody on a card has made more tackles. Career Legacy 7,563, Y88 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Daren Teamer
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game is a Hall of Fame habit, and Daren Teamer has never broken it. Career Legacy 8,087, Y89 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Kalif Suh
vault.text: A Jets linebacker since Y76, and the middle of that defense has rarely moved without him. Career Legacy 9,364, Y92 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jakeem Friend
vault.text: Linemen do not win trophies. Jakeem Friend won seven rings instead. Career Legacy 9,473, Y93 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lane McCoy
vault.text: Every time Denver got close to the goal line, the whole league knew who was getting the ball. Career Legacy 6,313, Y93 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Damar Hobbs
vault.text: No defender in league history has taken the ball away through the air more often than Damar Hobbs. Career Legacy 8,215, Y93 class.
